tools.name: sisoco_company_officers
tools.description: Lists the officers of a UK company as published by Companies House: directors, secretaries and LLP members, with role, appointment and resignation dates, nationality, occupation, country of residence and month and year of birth. tools.name: sisoco_get_lei_parents
tools.description: Returns the direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents reported to GLEIF (Level 2) for a Legal Entity Identifier, each with its LEI and name, or the reason no parent is reported (e.g. NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_CONSOLIDATING, NO_KNOWN_PERSON). Works for any country. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Cost: 1

tools.name: sisoco_get_lei_record
tools.description: Returns the GLEIF record for a Legal Entity Identifier: legal name, registered and headquarters addresses, legal form, registration authority and number, entity and registration status (e.g. LAPSED). For its parent companies call sisoco_get_lei_parents. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Cost: 1 lookup (same as G

tools.name: sisoco_ownership_chain
tools.description: Who owns and controls a UK company, up to its ultimate owners: reads the company's register of persons with significant control (Companies House), then the registers of its UK corporate owners, level by level, with cycle protection. tools.name: sisoco_recent_events
tools.description: Recent events stored for one entity, newest first, each with its type, severity, official source and source URL; event types are those of the packs this key can use. tools.name: sisoco_search_company
tools.description: Searches the Companies House register (UK) by name or number and returns matching companies with number, status and address. Use it to find the company number to pass to sisoco_check_company or sisoco_ownership_chain. For French companies call sisoco_check_company with the name and country FR. Cost:
